items.title: US Treasury intervenes to support yen through purchases - FT
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Treasury intervened in currency markets on Friday by purchasing yen, joining Japan’s efforts to support the currency from near four-decade lows, the Financial Times reported.

items.title: Morton Salt completes jumbo, $3.2B leveraged loan backing sponsor dividend
items.summary: Morton Salt has completed its $3.2 billion, five-year covenant-lite term loan B at S+275, with a 0% floor and an OID of 99.5 through a Morgan Stanley-led arranger group, according to sources. The TLB priced at the tight end of talk, with a $200 million upsizing, in a shift from a concurrent offering of senior unsecured notes.
